purpose: Teach: 池上/浅井/塩野/大村/亀山/成瀬/中沢/川村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の池上部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Let's give a proper welcome to Ikekami, our new department head.
lines.style: Clear, measured tone. Authoritative opening — this is directive, not suggestion. Slight weight on the name. Deliberate pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の浅井課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the travel schedule for Asai, our sales manager.
lines.style: Calm, professional affirmation. Even delivery. Taking mental note as he speaks. Efficient — the tone of someone already moving to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の塩野主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the project to Shiono from our technical division.
lines.style: Direct and decisive. Slight pause before the name — letting it land. Measured authority. No explanation needed tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の大村様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement the strategy that Omura from PR has proposed.
lines.style: Acknowledgment and confirmation. Steady, professional. A small nod in the voice. Moving forward without hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の亀山様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Consult with Kameyama, our advisor, on this matter.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Respectful but authoritative — this is about seeking counsel, not asking permission. Crisp articulation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の成瀬様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate with Naruse from accounting on the closing schedule.
lines.style: Quick, professional confirmation. The tone of checking boxes efficiently. No wasted words. Action-oriented.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の中沢様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Have Nakasawa from HR oversee the new employee training.
lines.style: Firm directive. Weight on the delegation. Clear expectation. Composed, no negotiation in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の川村様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that Kawamura from Legal reviews the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation — closing out the list. Professional, settled. A sense of wrapping up. Clear and concise.
